title: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, c
question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.

prediction.sql:
WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT order_id, customer_id FROM olist_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
base AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, oi.order_id, oi.price, oi.freight_value, o.customer_id
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN delivered o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
),
cust AS (
  SELECT b.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS val
  FROM base b
  JOIN olist_customers c ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY b.seller_id
),
prof AS (
  SELECT seller_id, SUM(price - freight_value) AS val
  FROM base
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
ord AS (
  SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS val
  FROM base
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
rev AS (
  SELECT b.seller_id, COUNT(*) AS val
  FROM base b
  JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON b.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE r.review_score = 5
  GROUP BY b.seller_id
),
cust_r AS (SELECT seller_id, val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) rn FROM cust),
prof_r AS (SELECT seller_id, val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) rn FROM prof),
ord_r  AS (SELECT seller_id, val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) rn FROM ord),
rev_r  AS (SELECT seller_id, val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) rn FROM rev)
SELECT 'Highest number of distinct customer unique IDs' AS achievement, seller_id, val FROM cust_r WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest profit (price minus freight value)', seller_id, val FROM prof_r WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest number of distinct orders', seller_id, val FROM ord_r WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, val FROM rev_r WHERE rn = 1;
